profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software developer proficient in Javascript stack, success driving full lifecycle development of web-based, and enterprise level applications across multiple platforms and environments.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Development for a global e-commerce seller intelligence platform serving customers across multiple regions. Using React, nodejs, golang, python, typescript, MySQL, AWS, Oracle cloud.
- Architected and implemented an automated event tracking system, reducing implementation time from hours to ~10 minutes while ensuring 100% spec-code consistency
- Spearheaded migration to micro-frontend architecture, improving team velocity by enabling parallel development across multiple products
- Designed and delivered cross-regional data analytics dashboards for enterprise clients (Fortune 500 brands), processing petabytes of market data
- Enhanced platform security through implementation of 2-factor authentication, user data normalization, and modernized authentication flows
- Established engineering best practices for code review, release management, A/B testing, and data analysis
- Mentored junior engineers and managed on-call rotations for a 24/7 platform with 99.9% uptime

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build a platform for customizing banking application flow with React, typescript, nodejs, PostgreSQL (Aurora).
- Designed and implemented data model layer system for dynamic form customization. Simplifying the entities structure and reduce complexity + conflict during db migration.
- Engineered real-time conflict resolution system for complex data layer operations, supporting concurrent editing by multiple users
- Implemented validation framework reducing production incidents by 80% through pre-deployment logical error detection
- Optimized application architecture to handle 10,000+ concurrent data entities while maintaining sub-second response times
- Led production monitoring and debugging initiatives using DataDog, Splunk, and PostgreSQL, achieving 99.95% system availabilit

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies used: ReactJS, Nodejs, Redux, Less, GraphQL, MS-SQL, dynamo DB, AWS-stack, Rancher + Kubernetes, Spring Boot, Selenium.

Achievements:
- Pioneer on research/migrating team services to new infrastructure using GitLab + Kubernetes + istio.
- Design, implement and maintain admin tool for various business strategic tasks ( advertisement, expansion, and survey management)
- Monitor and debug analytic data of the web application using Mode + presto + SQL. Discover and resolve critical issues that introduce invalid GA analytic data.
- Reduce page-load-time by 3 seconds for 90percentile of users, by optimizing the web application bundle, restructuring the loading flow with async/lazy loading, and applying partial hydrating.
- Improve the main web page ranking by implementing Server-side render and SEO improvement.
- Design and develop a dynamic questionnaire service that caters to different categories of users.
- Implement and maintain the review service for requests submitted through the dynamic questionnaire service.

Tasks:
- Project Sprint planning, estimating, project workflow retrospect, and other software development lifecycle stages.
- Improve and maintain unit, integration, and e2e testing coverage for products/services.
- Manage codebase of both backend and frontend of the services/products.
- Design and implement the User Interface in web applications with ReactJS, Nodejs, Redux, Less, and GraphQL.
- Design and maintain services that act as integration data central using SpringBoot, GraphQL.
- Design and maintain databases (Aurora, DynamoDB, Redis) that power the web servers.
- Design and maintain Single Page Application website (React, webpack).
- Design and maintain the user interaction analytic flow and create dashboards/alarms to monitor the metrics.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer
positions.description:
Technologies used: EmberJS, Nodejs, JQuery, Redux, Hbs, Less, MsSQL, ASP.Net MVC, Swagger.

- Maintaining and upgrading enterprise level Data Migration Service.
- Contribute to building the web app for an enterprise level Managed Service Platform.
- Contribute to building Content Management service, allowing user to create/edit/publish/share and management their documentations.
- Building the Automated Workflow service that allows user to ultlize the Platform API to create and schedule automated tasks.
- Design and implementing the Reporting portal and Statistic board which present the system healthcheck stats and resource statistics in visualized data graph/charts to end users.
- Design, implement and maintaining the REST API layer of the platform.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Work with AngularJs, JQuery, Lodash, Spring and Hibernate to develop the admin-console for an Data-Analysing product.
- Design and implement the front-end web application.
- Design and implement the REST API of the service.
- Develop modules features such as: Scheduling and Routing, Nodes and Service, User and Groups.
- Design the UI layout, styling for each apps with CSS3, HTML5.
- Refactoring legacy code, re-architecture core component and app page.

projects.description: Building extension module to the existed application.
